title: StepSearch: Igniting LLMs Search Ability via Step-Wise Proximal Policy Optimization
authors_zh: Xuhui Zheng, Kang An, Ziliang Wang, Yuhang Wang, Yichao Wu
paper_type_zh: Rollout、搜索或测试时推理轨迹研究
best_for_zh: 需要审计测试时轨迹、反馈与选择机制的读者
one_line: StepSearch: Igniting LLMs Search Ability via Step-Wise Proximal Policy Optimization records subquestion search trajectories under information-gain and redundancy intermediate feedback.
StepSearch 以检索信息增益与冗余惩罚为每一步搜索提供 PPO 反馈，处理后的监督语料仍未核验公开。
why: It makes step-wise PPO search action selection and its audit boundary visible for reasoning-data curation.
inclusion_reason: Approved Track 5 candidate with a concrete feedback/selection object: subquestion search trajectories.

title: Problem
问题
html: StepSearch addresses sparse supervision in reinforcement-learning-based multi-hop search. A single terminal answer score cannot identify which intermediate query retrieved useful evidence, which repeated prior work, or where a trajectory failed. The relevant data objects are therefore two related but distinct records: a constructed MuSiQue-derived supervision record containing decomposed subquestions, subanswers, reference search keywords, and retrieved-document evidence; and an online rollout containing repeated `think, search, and information rounds followed by answer`. The paper reports 60k filtered subquestion search keywords and uses 19k examples for training, but the accepted artifact record does not verify a downloadable corpus of the constructed records or raw RL rollouts. For the rollout/search/test-time trace track, the important unit is each search round together with its query, returned documents, accumulated retrieval history, step reward, and final outcome—not the benchmark score alone.

StepSearch 处理基于强化学习的多跳搜索中监督信号稀疏的问题。单一的终局答案分数无法指出哪一步查询取回了有用证据、哪一步重复了已有结果，或轨迹在何处失败。因此，相关数据对象分为两个彼此关联但不能混同的记录：其一是由 MuSiQue 构造的监督记录，包含分解后的子问题、子答案、参考搜索关键词和检索文档证据；其二是在线 rollout，其中反复出现 `think、search、information，最后以 answer` 结束。论文报告构造了 60k 条经过筛选的子问题搜索关键词，并使用其中 19k 条样本训练；但当前已接受的 artifact 记录尚未验证这些构造记录或原始 RL rollout 是否形成可下载语料。对 rollout、搜索与测试时轨迹这一分类而言，应审计的基本单元是每轮查询、返回文档、累计检索历史、步级奖励与最终结果，而不是只看 benchmark 分数。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: The contribution is StePPO, a PPO variant that places feedback at the search-round boundary instead of relying only on a terminal reward. Its global contract combines output-format enforcement, final-answer accuracy, and a search-key reward. For round t, the step reward is r_step(t) = G_t - P_t: information gain G_t measures the marginal improvement in TF–IDF cosine similarity between newly retrieved documents and the task’s ground-truth documents relative to the best match observed earlier, while redundancy penalty P_t is the fraction of current documents already present in retrieval history. The global reward is assigned at the final output position and the step reward at the final token of each search round. This is an automatically computed process signal grounded in gold-document coverage and retrieval overlap; it is not a human process annotation, learned judge, or proof that every selected query is semantically correct.

核心贡献是 StePPO：它在搜索轮次边界放置反馈，而不是只依赖终局奖励。其全局反馈契约由输出格式约束、最终答案正确性和 search-key reward 组成。对第 t 轮搜索，步级奖励为 r_step(t) = G_t - P_t：information gain G_t 衡量新检索文档相对历史最佳匹配，对任务 ground-truth documents 的 TF–IDF 余弦相似度带来的边际提升；redundancy penalty P_t 则是本轮文档中已在历史检索结果出现过的比例。全局奖励放在输出的最后位置，步级奖励放在每轮搜索行为的最后一个 token。该信号是依据黄金文档覆盖和检索重叠自动计算的过程反馈，不是人工过程标注、学习式 judge，也不能证明每个被奖励的查询在语义上都正确。

title: Method
方法
html:
Construction begins with decomposed questions from MuSiQue. GPT-4o is used to enrich them into coherent subquestion–answer pairs and to derive N candidate search queries per step. Queries are issued to M sources, with Google, Bing, and Wiki-18 given as examples; a query is retained only if it returns valid results in at least ceil(M/2) sources. The paper reports 60k filtered search keywords, while 19k MuSiQue-derived examples are used for RL training; the exact verified values of N and M, a complete release manifest, and record-level rejection logs remain unknown.

During rollout, Qwen2.5 3B or 7B Base/Instruct models follow a three-demonstration prompt and iterate through `think, search, and externally supplied information blocks until producing answer or exhausting the action budget. Retrieved information tokens are masked from the optimization loss. The implementation builds on Search-R1 and verl. Training uses E5 retrieval over the synthesized corpus; evaluation augments the corpus with the 2018 Wikipedia dump and retrieves k=3 documents. The appendix reports rollout temperature 1.0, top_p=1.0, KL coefficient 1e-3`, and PPO clipping ratio 0.2. The paper does not establish a frozen search-service snapshot, complete per-record reward logs, or a released replayable environment.

构造流程从 MuSiQue 已分解的问题开始。作者使用 GPT-4o 将其扩充为连贯的子问题—子答案对，并为每一步生成 N 个候选搜索查询。查询被发送到 M 个来源，论文以 Google、Bing 和 Wiki-18 为例；只有在至少 ceil(M/2) 个来源中返回有效结果的查询才会被保留。论文报告得到 60k 条经过筛选的搜索关键词，其中 19k 条 MuSiQue 派生样本用于 RL 训练；N 与 M 的已核验具体取值、完整发布清单以及逐记录拒绝日志仍为 unknown。

在线 rollout 使用 Qwen2.5 3B 或 7B 的 Base/Instruct 模型，通过含三个示例的提示反复执行 `think、search 和外部返回的 information，直到输出 answer 或耗尽 action budget。训练时，检索得到的 information token 不参与优化损失。实现基于 Search-R1 和 verl；训练阶段使用 E5 在合成语料上检索，评测阶段加入 2018 Wikipedia dump，并固定检索 k=3 篇文档。附录报告 rollout temperature 为 1.0、top_p=1.0、KL 系数为 1e-3`、PPO clipping ratio 为 0.2。论文没有建立冻结的搜索服务快照、完整的逐记录奖励日志或已发布的可重放环境。

title: Evidence
证据
html: The paper evaluates Qwen2.5 3B and 7B Base/Instruct models on HotpotQA, 2WikiMultiHopQA, MuSiQue, and Bamboogle using Exact Match and word-level F1, explicitly avoiding third-party LLM judges. It reports absolute improvements of 11.2 points for 3B and 4.2 points for 7B over search-RL baselines with 19k training examples. The Qwen2.5-7B-Base ablation provides more mechanism-specific evidence: removing the full step reward changes F1 from 0.493 to 0.475 on HotpotQA, 0.450 to 0.433 on 2WikiMultiHopQA, 0.324 to 0.283 on MuSiQue, and 0.573 to 0.485 on Bamboogle. Additional training curves and cases describe repetitive searches and reward collapse when only a global search-key score is used. These results support the usefulness of step-wise feedback within the reported setup; they do not verify the accuracy, completeness, provenance, or release quality of every constructed supervision record.

论文在 HotpotQA、2WikiMultiHopQA、MuSiQue 和 Bamboogle 上评测 Qwen2.5 3B 与 7B 的 Base/Instruct 模型，指标为 Exact Match 和词级 F1，并明确不使用第三方 LLM judge。作者报告，在使用 19k 条训练样本时，相对 search-RL baselines，3B 和 7B 模型分别获得 11.2 与 4.2 个点的绝对提升。Qwen2.5-7B-Base 的消融更直接地检验机制：移除完整 step reward 后，HotpotQA 的 F1 从 0.493 变为 0.475，2WikiMultiHopQA 从 0.450 变为 0.433，MuSiQue 从 0.324 变为 0.283，Bamboogle 从 0.573 变为 0.485。训练曲线和案例还描述了重复搜索，以及仅使用全局 search-key score 时出现的 reward collapse。这些结果支持步级反馈在论文设定中的作用，但不能验证每条构造监督记录的准确性、完整性、来源谱系或发布质量。

title: Novelty
新意
html: Relative to Search-R1-style search RL with primarily global outcome signals, StepSearch makes intermediate retrieval behavior directly optimizable: gold-document information gain and retrieval-history redundancy are converted into round-local token rewards. It also couples that reward contract to a MuSiQue-based pipeline for subquestion-aligned search keywords. For this atlas, the direction signal is the explicit linkage among a constructed reference object, an online search trajectory, a process reward, and a terminal QA outcome. PPO, MuSiQue, Qwen2.5, iterative `search` tool use, E5 retrieval, and final-answer rewards are reused components rather than new contributions. The claimed novelty should therefore be compared at the feedback placement and trace-field level, not inferred from final benchmark rank.

相较于主要依赖全局结果信号的 Search-R1 式 search RL，StepSearch 使中间检索行为可以被直接优化：它把相对黄金文档的信息增益和相对检索历史的冗余度转换为轮次局部的 token 奖励，并将该反馈契约与基于 MuSiQue 的子问题对齐搜索关键词构造流程结合起来。对本图谱而言，其方向性信号是显式连接构造参考对象、在线搜索轨迹、过程奖励与终局 QA 结果。PPO、MuSiQue、Qwen2.5、迭代式 `search` 工具调用、E5 检索和最终答案奖励均为复用组件，并非新的贡献。因此，应在反馈放置方式和轨迹字段层面比较其新意，不能从最终 benchmark 排名反推。

title: Limitations
局限
html: The authors evaluate only text QA and Qwen2.5 models at 3B and 7B scale; behavior on multimodal tasks, other agent environments, or 14B/32B models is unknown. Training uses 19k MuSiQue-derived examples, so the paper does not establish how StepSearch compares with Search-R1 at matched data scale. Reward collapse and unstable training remain observed risks. The step reward depends on access to ground-truth documents and TF–IDF lexical similarity, which may not transfer to open-ended tasks without gold evidence and may reward surface overlap rather than factual utility. Construction also depends on GPT-4o and multiple search sources whose versions and result snapshots are not fully pinned. A downloadable trajectory corpus, rejected-query records, per-step reward logs, dataset license, decontamination procedure, and end-to-end replay protocol are not verified by the accepted artifact metadata. Public code and benchmark gains must not be treated as evidence that those data artifacts are reusable or individually correct.

作者只评测了文本 QA，以及 3B 和 7B 规模的 Qwen2.5；对多模态任务、其他 agent environment 或 14B/32B 模型的表现仍为 unknown。训练仅使用 19k 条 MuSiQue 派生样本，因此论文没有建立与 Search-R1 在相同数据规模下的比较结论。Reward collapse 和训练不稳定仍是已观察到的风险。步级奖励依赖 ground-truth documents 与 TF–IDF 词汇相似度；在缺少黄金证据的开放任务中可能无法迁移，也可能奖励表面重叠而非事实效用。构造流程还依赖 GPT-4o 和多个搜索来源，但其版本与结果快照未被完整固定。当前已接受的 artifact metadata 尚未验证可下载的轨迹语料、被拒查询记录、逐步奖励日志、数据集许可证、去污染流程和端到端 replay protocol。公开代码和 benchmark 提升不能被当作这些数据 artifact 可复用或逐条正确的证据。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: For the rollout/search/test-time trace data track, StepSearch is useful as a schema and recipe example. A reusable record would preserve the original question, decomposed subquestions, candidate query, returned document identifiers or snapshots, retrieval-history state, information-gain term, redundancy term, total step reward, format and answer rewards, stopping reason, and final answer. Such records could support agent RL, process-reward ablations, verifier calibration, query-policy analysis, and comparisons between global and step-wise supervision. The paper supports agent training and test-time search research, but the Card does not claim that an independently reusable StepSearch trajectory dataset is currently verified.

对 rollout、搜索与测试时轨迹数据这一分类，StepSearch 可作为数据 schema 和构造 recipe 的实例。若要形成可复用记录，应保存原始问题、分解后的子问题、候选查询、返回文档标识或快照、检索历史状态、information-gain 项、redundancy 项、总 step reward、格式与答案奖励、停止原因和最终答案。这类记录可用于 agent RL、过程奖励消融、verifier 校准、查询策略分析，以及全局监督与步级监督的比较。论文为 agent training 和测试时搜索研究提供了依据，但本 Card 不声称目前已经核验到可独立复用的 StepSearch 轨迹数据集。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Verify whether the public repository actually contains the 60k filtered keywords, the 19k training subset, raw online rollouts, rejected candidates, and per-step reward fields; record each artifact separately.
  • Recompute G_t and P_t on sampled records from retrieved-document snapshots, checking whether TF–IDF overlap matches factual information gain and whether duplicate detection is stable.
  • Audit MuSiQue lineage, GPT-4o generation prompts, N/M candidate settings, source-consensus filtering, dataset license, and decontamination; keep absent fields unknown.
  • Reproduce the matched ablation with frozen retrieval indexes, identical action budgets, seeds, and model checkpoints so retrieval drift and compute do not masquerade as reward improvements.
  • Inspect failed and high-reward trajectories for format exploitation, repetitive searches, phantom answers, and reward collapse; do not infer record-level quality from aggregate EM/F1.

• 核验公开代码库是否实际包含 60k 条筛选关键词、19k 训练子集、原始在线 rollout、被拒候选和逐步奖励字段，并分别记录每类 artifact。
  • 基于检索文档快照抽样重算 G_t 与 P_t，检查 TF–IDF 重叠是否对应事实信息增益，以及重复检测是否稳定。
  • 审计 MuSiQue 谱系、GPT-4o 生成提示、N/M 候选设置、多来源一致性筛选、数据集许可证和去污染流程；缺失字段继续记为 unknown。
  • 在冻结检索索引、统一 action budget、随机种子和模型 checkpoint 的条件下复现匹配消融，避免检索漂移或计算量差异伪装成奖励机制改进。
  • 检查失败轨迹与高奖励轨迹中的格式投机、重复搜索、phantom answer 和 reward collapse；不得从汇总 EM/F1 推断逐记录数据质量。
